articles.headline: Tesla Stock Is Down 17% Over the Past Year. Buy Now or Wait for Merger Terms?
articles.summary: Tesla stock is down 17.1% over the past year, closing at $372.22 on October 23, following a second-quarter report that showed a $1.1 billion cash burn and a spending plan exceeding $25 billion. Free cash flow later swung back to $1.53 billion as Tesla cut its 2026 capital expenditure guide to about $20 billion, though shares fell 2% the next day amid doubts over the pace of its AI and robotics push. SpaceX stated that any Tesla merger would require approval from Musk as its controlling shareholder, and no terms currently exist. CFO Vaibhav Taneja reported that capex for the next few years would continue to expand, with Tesla securing capacity to borrow up to $30 billion and maintaining more than $45 billion in cash and investments.
articles.summary_zh: 特斯拉股价在过去一年中下跌了17.1%，10月23日收盘价为372.22美元。 此前第二季度报告显示有11亿美元的现金消耗，并伴随超过250亿美元的开支计划。 随着特斯拉将其2026年资本支出指引下调至约200亿美元，自由现金流随后回升至$1.53 billion，但在对人工智能和机器人推进速度的疑虑中，股价在次日下跌了2%。 SpaceX表示，任何特斯拉合并都需要作为控股股东的马斯克的批准，且目前尚无任何条款。 首席财务官瓦伊巴夫·塔内贾在财报电话会议上表示，未来几年的资本支出将继续扩大，特斯拉已获得高达300亿美元的借款能力，并拥有超过450亿美元的现金和投资。

articles.headline: What To Expect In Markets This Week: GOOGL, MSFT, AMZN, INTC, HOOD, LLY Earnings, Fed Meeting And More
articles.summary: Major technology companies including Alphabet, Microsoft, and Amazon are set to report their quarterly results, placing massive AI investments in focus as investors search for signs that spending translates into growth. Alphabet and Microsoft are scheduled to report on Wednesday after market close, followed by Amazon on Thursday. Fiscal. ai data projects Alphabet to report $3 earnings per share on $127.83 billion in revenue for the July-September quarter, Microsoft to report $4.72 earnings per share on $90.75 billion in revenue, and Amazon to report $1.96 earnings per share on $202.2 billion in revenue. Additionally, the Federal Open Market Committee will begin a two-day meeting on Tuesday with its policy decision set for Wednesday, while Intel is expected to report earnings per share of $0.4 on revenue of $16.47 billion alongside numerous other corporate earnings.
articles.summary_zh: 包括Alphabet、微软和亚马逊在内的主要科技公司将公布季度业绩，随着投资者寻找支出转化为增长的迹象，巨额人工智能投资成为焦点。 Alphabet和微软计划于周三收盘后发布财报，亚马逊则于周四发布。 Fiscal. ai数据预计，Alphabet在7月至9月季度每股收益为3美元，营收为12783亿美元；微软每股收益为4.72美元，营收为9075亿美元；亚马逊每股收益为1.96美元，营收为20220亿美元。 此外，联邦公开市场委员会将于周二开始为期两天的会议，政策决定定于周三宣布，同时英特尔预计每股收益为0.4美元，营收为1647亿美元，多家中企业也将公布财报。

articles.headline: Will AI Data Center Explosive Growth Save STM Stock on Oct. 29?
articles.summary: STMicroelectronics shares have dropped 16.09% over the past month ahead of its October 29 third-quarter earnings report, which will test whether AI data center demand can support the stock. In the previous quarter, revenue rose 24.5% year over year to $3.49 billion, non-GAAP earnings per share reached $0.31, and free cash flow turned positive at $75 million, though the stock fell 18.67% on the day of the report. CEO Jean-Marc Chery noted that third-quarter guidance calls for $3.7 billion in revenue at the midpoint with a gross margin of about 37%. Management raised its data center target to more than $1 billion for 2026 and well above $2 billion for 2027, driven mainly by optical connectivity and a multi-year deal with Amazon Web Services that includes warrants for up to 24.8 million shares.
articles.summary_zh: 意法半导体股价在一个月内下跌了16.09%，即将迎来10月29日的第三季度财报，该财报将检验人工智能数据中心需求能否支撑股价。 上一季度，营收同比增长24.5%至34.9亿美元，非美国通用会计准则每股收益达到0.31美元，自由现金流转为正值达7500万美元，尽管财报发布当日股价下跌了18.67%。 首席执行官让-马克·谢瑞指出，第三季度业绩指引中点营收为37亿美元，毛利率约为37%。 管理层将2026年数据中心目标提高至逾10亿美元，2027年提高至远超20亿美元，主要由光连接以及与亚马逊云科技包含多达2480万股认股权证的多年生协议所驱动。

articles.headline: S&P500: AI Spending, Big Tech Earnings and Fed Risk Test US Stock Market
articles.summary: The S&P 500 Index finished lower for a second straight week, driven by technology sector weakness as investors reacted to heavy corporate spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure, highlighted by Meta Platforms reporting negative free cash flow as AI spending surged by nearly 80%. Semiconductor makers like Lam Research dropped amid supply chain challenges, and Tesla faced pressure after revenue fell short of forecasts. Rising oil prices due to Middle East political tensions also weighed on the market, sparking inflation and Federal Reserve rate hike fears, while investors awaited the Fed's interest rate decision and the PCE inflation report. Caterpillar settled down 5.99% at $687.00, trading below its 52-week moving average of $761.50 ahead of its Thursday earnings report.
articles.summary_zh: 标普500指数连续第二周下跌，主要由于科技板块疲软，投资者对人工智能基础设施的大举企业支出作出反应，其中Meta Platforms因人工智能支出飙升近80%而报告自由现金流为负尤为引人注目。 受供应链挑战影响，Lam Research等半导体制造商下跌，特斯拉在营收未达预期后也面临压力。 中东政治紧张局势导致油价上涨，这也拖累了市场，引发了对通胀和美联储加息的担忧，同时投资者正等待美联储的利率决定和PCE通胀报告。 卡特彼勒收盘下跌5.99%至687.00美元，在周四财报发布前交投于761.50美元的52周移动平均线下方。

articles.headline: Should Tesla (TSLA) Investors Care About Elon Musk Confirming Formal Merger Talks?
articles.summary: Tesla designs, develops, manufactures, leases, and sells electric vehicles as well as energy generation and storage systems in the United States, China, and internationally, maintaining a balance sheet with growth potential. Market discussions surrounding the company highlight the impact of physical AI workloads and AI factory demand, while broader commentary observes how artificial intelligence narratives repeatedly shift valuations across sectors such as cybersecurity without fundamental business changes. Additional market analysis features updates on various natural resource projects, dividend efficiencies in ASEAN markets, and alternative investment insights.
articles.summary_zh: 特斯拉在美国、中国及国际市场设计、开发、制造、租赁和销售电动汽车以及能源生成和存储系统，并维持着具备增长潜力的资产负债表。 围绕该公司的主流讨论突显了物理人工智能工作负载和人工智能工厂需求的影响，而更广泛的评论则观察到人工智能叙事如何在没有根本业务变化的情况下，反复改变网络安全等板块的估值。 其他市场分析还包括关于各种自然资源项目、东盟市场股息效率以及另类投资见解的最新动态。

articles.headline: 3 AI Stocks That Can Beat the Nasdaq Composite in 2027
articles.summary: Dell and Silicon Motion Technology are highlighted as AI-focused stocks that can outperform the Nasdaq Composite in 2027. Dell reported a $95 billion backlog and $47 billion in revenue for its fiscal 2027 second quarter ended July 31, driven by its infrastructure solutions group and partnerships with Nvidia. Silicon Motion Technology specializes in NAND flash controllers for solid-state drives and enterprise AI data centers, serving major chipmakers like Micron, Sandisk, and SK Hynix.
articles.summary_zh: 戴尔和慧荣科技被视为有望在2027年跑赢纳斯达克综合指数的人工智能股票。 截至7月31日的2027财年第二季度，戴尔公布了950亿美元的订单积压和470亿美元的收入，这得益于其基础设施解决方案集团以及与英伟达的合作。 慧荣科技专门从事固态硬盘和企业级人工智能数据中心的NAND闪存控制器，主要客户包括美光、闪迪和SK海力士等芯片制造商。

articles.headline: US Stocks Close: Dow Drops Over 600 Points, Some Tech Stocks Rebound, CrowdStrike Gains Over 8%
articles.summary: U. S. stocks diverged on October 23 as consumer and healthcare sectors declined and WTI crude topped $100 per barrel amid US-Iran conflict concerns. The Dow fell 1.23% to 52,215.16, the S&P 500 lost 0.52% to 7,623.68, and the Nasdaq dropped 0.21% to 25,955.34. CrowdStrike rose 8.25% to $257.57 following a critical PHP security vulnerability. In corporate and geopolitical news, SpaceX discussed accessing roughly 80,000 cell towers and faced potential antitrust risks in a Tesla merger, Intel obtained a one-year FCC waiver for robotic equipment, and Iranian officials stated a subsea cable strike plan was formulated.
articles.summary_zh: 美东时间10月23日，由于消费和医疗板块下跌，且在美伊冲突担忧下WTI原油突破每桶100美元，美股出现分化。 道琼斯指数下跌1.23%收于52,215.16点，标普500指数下跌0.52%收于7,623.68点，纳斯达克指数下跌0.21%收于25,955.34点。 受重大PHP安全漏洞影响，CrowdStrike上涨8.25%至257.57美元。 在企业与地缘政治动态方面，SpaceX正讨论接入约8万座手机基站且与特斯拉合并面临潜在反垄断风险，英特尔获得了美国联邦通信委员会为期一年的机器人设备豁免，伊朗官员则表示已制定海底电缆打击计划。

articles.headline: Alibaba Group Holding Limited (BABA) - What Are Analysts Saying About This Stock?
articles.summary: Alibaba Group Holding Limited holds an average 'Moderate Buy' recommendation from 21 analysts, with a 1-year average price objective of $182.89. Recent analyst actions include Weiss Ratings upgrading the stock to a 'hold (c)' rating, Jefferies reiterating a 'buy' rating with a $192.00 price objective, HSBC setting a $170.00 price objective, Susquehanna raising its target price to $190.00, and Sanford C. Bernstein issuing a $165.00 target price. In insider activity, General Counsel Siying Yu and CFO Hong Xu sold shares to cover tax withholding obligations. Additionally, Erste Group Bank raised its FY2027 and FY2028 EPS estimates, and Alibaba contributed OpenSandbox to the Agentic AI Foundation.
articles.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴集团控股有限公司获得了21位分析师给予的平均“适度买入”评级，1年平均目标价为182.89美元。 近期分析师行动包括Weiss Ratings将该股票上调至“持有(c)”评级，杰富瑞重申“买入”评级并设定192.00美元的目标价，汇丰设定170.00美元的目标价，海纳国际将目标价从185.00美元上调至190.00美元，伯恩斯坦发布了165.00美元的目标价。 在内部交易方面，总法律顾问于思莹和首席财务官徐宏为涵盖税收扣缴义务而出售了股份。 此外，erste集团银行上调了2027财年和2028财年的每股收益预估，且阿里巴巴向Agentic AI Foundation贡献了OpenSandbox。

articles.headline: 今週の決算発表予定 キオクシア、アドテスト、レーザーテクなど (10月26日～30日)(株探ニュース)
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: A schedule of earnings announcements for Japanese companies from October 26 to October 31 lists multiple firms reporting fiscal second-quarter results ending in March 2027. Notable companies on the calendar include Shin-Etsu Chemical on October 27, Hitachi, Socionext, NEC, and Advantest on October 28, JT, Ibiden, Takeda Pharmaceutical, OLC, Komatsu, Fujitsu, Renesas, Denso, and Tokyo Electric Power Company on October 29, followed by Kioxia, Sumitomo Pharma, Daiichi Sankyo, Sumitomo Electric, Mitsubishi Electric, Panasonic Holdings, TDK, Lasertec, Murata Manufacturing, Screen Holdings, and Tokyo Electron on October 30.
articles.summary_zh: 公布了10月26日至10月31日日本企业的财报发布日程，多家公司将发布截至2027年3月的财年第二季度业绩。 日程上的知名企业包括10月27日的信越化学，10月28日的日立、Socionext、NEC和爱测试，10月29日的JT、揖斐电、武田药品、OLC、小松、富士通、瑞萨、电装和东京电力公司，以及10月30日的铠侠、住友制药、第一三共、住友电气、三菱电机、松下控股、TDK、激光技术、村田制作所、迪恩士和东京电子。

articles.headline: AIバブル崩壊懸念のなかでも株価が崩れない「日立製作所」の強み 傘下の日立エナジーは受注残10兆円超、データセンターの急所「送配電網構築」で圧倒的な技術力
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: Hitachi is highlighted for its growth potential due to its subsidiary Hitachi Energy having an order backlog exceeding 10 trillion yen amid rising AI investment and power grid bottlenecks. On October 15, the Nikkei average fell 3,318 points, and Microsoft terminated a UK AI data center contract with Nscale due to power grid connection delays rather than advanced semiconductor shortages. The planned data center originally intended to use 23,040 Nvidia GB300 GPUs for Azure but faced power grid delays stretching into the 2030s. AI servers and cooling systems consume substantial electricity, causing a structural mismatch where grid infrastructure lags behind GPU procurement.
articles.summary_zh: 日立因其子公司日立エナジー在人工智能投资上升和电网瓶颈背景下订单积压超过10万亿日元而受到关注。 10月15日，日经平均指数下跌3,318点，微软因电网连接延迟而非先进半导体短缺，终止了与英国AI云企业Nscale的数据中心利用合同。 该计划中的数据中心原本打算为Azure使用23,040个英伟达GB300 GPU，但面临延伸至2030年代的电网延误。 人工智能服务器和冷却系统消耗大量电力，导致电网基础设施落后于GPU采购的结构性供需不匹配。

articles.headline: 視る日経！ニュースNEXT▼働き方改革・企業はどう向き合う？／日経平均AIの懸念は
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: テレビ東京の番組「視る日経！ ニュースNEXT」では、日本の「働き方改革」の行方について議論している。 厚生労働省は終業から次の始業までに一定時間を置く「勤務間インターバル制度」の普及や見直しを検討している。 一方、勤務時間外の連絡を規制する「つながらない権利」については、フランスやスペインなどで法制化されているものの、日本にはまだ制度がない。 番組では、過重労働を防ぐ仕組みの今後と経済への影響を取り上げる。
articles.summary_zh: 东京电视台节目“视る日経！ ニュースNEXT”探讨了日本“工作方式改革”的进展。 日本厚生劳动省正在讨论普及或重新评估“间隔休息制度”，即在下班和次日上班之间保留一定的时间间隔。 另一方面，对于监管下班后工作相关联络的“断联权”，法国和西班牙等国已将其法律化，而日本尚无相关制度。 节目探讨了防止过劳机制的未来及其对经济的影响。

articles.headline: 【日本シリーズ】横浜スタジアムが凍りついた初球 ソフトバンク正木智也「幻の一発」の衝撃
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 2026年10月24日、横浜スタジアムで日本シリーズが開幕し、ソフトバンクの正木智也がDeNAの先発・石田裕太郎から初球を捉えて左翼ポール際へ大飛球を放った。 ソフトバンクは2024年の日本シリーズでDeNAに2勝4敗で敗れており、その第6戦終了時刻から今年の第1試合プレイボール予定時刻までの時間を算出した画像を公式SNSに投稿していた。 試合は雨の影響で6分遅れの午後6時36分に開始された。
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月24日，日本系列赛在横滨球场开幕，软银队的一号打者正木智也抓住了DeNA先发投手石田裕太郎投出的第一球，将球击向左外野标志杆附近。 软银在2024年的日本系列赛中以两胜四负输给DeNA，其官方社交媒体曾发布图片，计算了那场第六场比赛结束到今年第一场比赛预计开球时间之间的小时数。 由于下雨，比赛推迟6分钟于下午6点36分开始。

articles.headline: 固体電池の研究が拡大する中、投資家はトヨタ株にどう反応しているか
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: トヨタ自動車は、次世代全固体電池市場に関する報告書で言及されており、研究や投資の増加が指摘されている。 この全固体電池への注力は、同社のマルチパスウェイ電動化戦略を再構築する可能性がある。 トヨタは2027年度までに約600万台の電動化車両販売を計画しており、ミシガン州でのLGエナジーソリューションとの電池セル合弁事業も進められている。 事業計画では2029年までに売上高57兆3,752億円、利益4兆3,111億円が見込まれている。
articles.summary_zh: 丰田汽车在一份关于全球下一代全固态电池市场的报告中被提及，其中指出相关的投资和研究活动正在增加。 这种对全固态电池的关注可能会重塑该公司的“多路径”电动化投资战略。 丰田计划到2027财年销售约600万辆电动化车辆，并且正在推进与LG新能源在密歇根州的电池单元合资项目。 根据业务计划，丰田预计到2029年销售额将达到573,752亿日元，利润为43,111亿日元。

articles.headline: Japanese Regional Bank Stocks That Could Benefit From A Steeper Yield Curve
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: As central banks steer interest rate expectations, Japan's regional lenders face new opportunities and traps amid a steeper yield curve. Mebuki Financial Group Inc earns essentially all of its ¥377.6b in revenue from traditional banking, with a market value around ¥1.36t, tying its earnings closely to the gap between deposit rates and loan returns. North Pacific Bank Ltd, based in Sapporo, generates about ¥232.2b in revenue with a market value near ¥413.0b, focusing on everyday banking and matching local deposits with home, personal, and business loans.
articles.summary_zh: 随着各大央行引导利率预期，日本地方借贷机构在收益率曲线变陡的背景下面临新的机遇与陷阱。 筑波银行等母公司常阳银行所在的芽吹金融集团（Mebuki Financial Group Inc）的3776亿日元收入基本上全部来自日本的传统银行业务，市值约为1.36万亿日元，其收益与存款利率和贷款回报之间的差距密切相关。 总部位于札幌的北方银行（North Pacific Bank Ltd）创造了约2322亿日元的收入，市值接近4130亿日元，专注于日常银行业务，将本地存款与日元住房、个人和商业贷款相匹配。

articles.headline: With Oil Prices Rising, Bitcoin Remains Stuck Below $85,000. Here's Why I'm Still Buying Bitcoin Right Now.
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Between July and September, Bitcoin soared from $60,000 to $87,000, but in October it fell 2% as soaring oil prices hovered around $100. The article outlines the oil feedback mechanism where rising oil prices cause inflation fears and push central banks to raise rates, leading to a sell-off in risk assets like Bitcoin. Historically, however, long-term rolling correlation coefficients between Bitcoin and major oil benchmarks hover around 0, showing no persistent correlation. Meanwhile, other events like SpaceX reporting higher revenue can also influence Bitcoin's price movements on a daily basis.
articles.summary_zh: 在7月至9月期间，比特币从$60,000飙升至$87,000，但在10月下跌了2%，因为暴涨的油价徘徊在$100左右。 文章概述了石油反馈机制，即油价上涨引发通胀担忧，并促使央行加息，导致比特币等风险资产遭到抛售。 然而，从历史上看，比特币与主要石油基准之间的长期滚动相关系数在0左右徘徊，显示出并没有持续的相关性。 同时，像SpaceX报告更高收入等其他事件也会在日常层面上影响比特币的价格变动。

articles.headline: Crypto Crash: Why the Top Cryptos Lost Up to 4% in One Week
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: In the week ending October 25, 2026, the crypto market experienced a prolonged downturn driven by macroeconomic factors rather than crypto-specific issues. Four of the five largest non-stablecoin cryptocurrencies closed the week in the red. Bitcoin fell 2.27% to end at $80,217, while Ethereum dropped 3.95% to close at $2,324. The wider market pressures included higher-than-expected US consumer price index inflation at 3.7% for September, rising oil prices and Treasury yields, ongoing US spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF outflows, and large-scale leveraged long position liquidations. Year to date, Bitcoin is down 8.34% and Ethereum is down 21.67%, with Ethereum suffering additional downward pressure from heavy futures leverage and decentralized finance collateral liquidation loops.
articles.summary_zh: 在截至2026年10月25日的一周内，加密货币市场经历持续低迷，主要受宏观经济因素而非加密货币自身问题驱动。 除稳定币外市值最大的五种加密货币中，有四种以下跌收盘。 比特币下跌2.27%，收于$80,217；以太坊下跌3.95%，收于$2,324。 更广泛的市场压力包括美国9月消费者价格指数通胀率高于预期达到3.7%、油价和国债收益率上升、美国现货比特币和以太坊ETF持续资金流出，以及大规模杠杆多头头寸遭到清算。 今年迄今为止，比特币下跌8.34%，以太坊下跌21.67%，由于期货杠杆率较高以及去中心化金融抵押品清算循环，以太坊承受了额外的下行压力。

articles.headline: Euro sinks on French debt worries; yen gains for week on AI rout
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: The euro fell on Friday, October 23, heading for a weekly loss against the US dollar and the yen due to a sell-off in French government bonds that pushed the country's debt risk premium to its highest level since the 2011 eurozone sovereign debt crisis. France deployed 70,000 police for protests over underfunded schools and living costs, while Moody's threatened a rating downgrade. The euro traded down 0.21 per cent at US$1.1191, down 0.43 per cent for the week, and dropped against the yen to 175.08 yen. Meanwhile, the US dollar index rose 0.25 per cent to 101.82, and the Japanese yen benefited from safe-haven flows following an artificial intelligence stock sell-off. Eurozone private-sector growth slowed in October to its weakest pace in four months. Traders are awaiting upcoming policy meetings from the US Federal Reserve, European Central Bank, and Bank of Japan, all expected to leave rates unchanged.
articles.summary_zh: 由于法国政府债券遭到抛售，导致该国债务风险溢价升至2011年欧元区主权债务危机以来的最高水平，欧元在10月23日星期五下跌，兑美元和日元均录得周跌幅。 法国部署了7万名警察应对抗议学校资金不足和生活成本的游行，同时穆迪曾发出下调评级威胁。 欧元最后下跌0.21%至US$1.1191，周跌幅为0.43%，兑日元跌至175.08日元。 与此同时，美元指数上涨0.25%至101.82，日元则在人工智能股票遭到抛售后受益于避险资金流入。 欧元区10月私营部门增长放缓至四个月来最弱水平。 交易员正等待美国联邦储备委员会、欧洲央行和日本银行即将召开的政策会议，预计这三家央行均将维持利率不变。

articles.headline: Gold prices next week: The $4,000/oz mark faces a test.
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Gold prices extended a sharp weekly decline, dropping below the $4,000/oz mark as rising oil prices, persistent inflation concerns, and US Federal Reserve tightening expectations outweighed safe-haven demand. Spot gold opened at $4,164.69 per ounce and hit a weekly high of $4,190.17/oz before technology stock liquidations triggered widespread selling on Thursday, pushing prices to a weekly low of $3,975.10 per ounce on Friday, the lowest level since early June. Kitco News weekly survey showed divided sentiment, with 24% of experts predicting a rise, 41% predicting a decline, and 35% neutral or stable, while individual investors showed 42% expecting higher prices, 26% lower prices, and 33% consolidation. Analysts Marc Chandler and Sean Lusk noted that ongoing Middle East tensions, oil price impacts on inflation, and potential central bank rate hikes continue to limit gold's recovery potential.
articles.summary_zh: 由于油价上涨、持续的通货膨胀担忧以及美国联邦储备委员会进一步收紧政策的预期超过了避险需求，金价延续了急剧的周跌幅，跌破了$4,000/oz关口。 现货黄金开盘价为每盎司$4,164.69，曾触及$4,190.17/oz的周高点，随后在周四因科技股遭到清算而引发广泛抛售，导致金价在周五跌至每盎司$3,975.10的周内低点，创下6月初以来的最低水平。 Kitco News的每周调查显示市场情绪分歧，24%的专家预测上涨，41%预测下跌，35%持平或稳定；而个人投资者中有42%预计价格上涨，26%预计下跌，33%预计进入盘整期。 分析师马克·钱德勒和肖恩·拉斯克指出，中东持续紧张局势、油价对通胀的影响以及潜在的央行加息继续限制了黄金的回升潜力。
